newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mostly higher before FOMC.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mostly higher before FOMC.

text.p: Feb 3 - IMM currency futures ended mostly higher before US FOMC meeting starting Tuesday. Few look for change in U.S. rates. Late trade picked up as dealers bought marks, on both sides in Swiss after franc's earlier knee-jerk rise. Sterling rose after stronger UK manufacturing data, on technicals. Treasury's Rubin reiterated US dollar policy unchanged. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
